decisions.decision: Push mode only for now — fling mode UI hidden, selectedMode hardcoded to 'push'
decisions.rationale: Ship a polished single mode rather than two half-finished modes

decisions.decision: Vanilla JS + Matter.js, no build system, Canvas 2D
decisions.rationale: No build complexity for a game of this scope; Matter.js loaded via CDN
Modern, fast, ESM-native — compatible with the project's ES6 module structure

decisions.decision: Add hit combo multiplier to push mode: each hit within 1s raises damage by 0.5×, capped at 3.0×
decisions.rationale: Rewards skilled rapid swinging without changing the core one-hit-ideal scoring loop

decisions.decision: Keep fling mode as a selectable second mode; push mode is the default and primary
decisions.rationale: Both mechanics are worth keeping — push for sustained swinging, fling for projectile precision

decisions.decision: Remove fling mode entirely — delete RELEASED state, fling input handling, and mode picker UI
decisions.rationale: Simplify the codebase to a single polished mode; fling was never the primary experience and adds dead code

decisions.decision: Full retheme: replace yoyo with procedurally drawn rat; giblet shatter; 4 damage states (healthy/dazed/injured/critical); layered commits (player-facing first, internal rename second)
decisions.rationale: User requested tone/theme change; layered approach keeps each commit reviewable and game in working state throughout

decisions.decision: Redesign levels as 9 levels in 3 acts (Sewer/Warehouse/Lab); Act 2 introduces destructible shields; Act 3 introduces bumpers; act-grouped level select with ACT CLEAR screen
decisions.rationale: Levels felt samey with no new mechanics; acts provide structure and escalation; shields/bumpers implementable with existing physics primitives

decisions.decision: Items 35+36 combined: PointerEvents API in input.js + CSS transform scaling via fitToViewport() in main.js
decisions.rationale: Single codepath for mouse and touch; getBoundingClientRect in getCanvasXY automatically compensates for CSS scale transform, so no coordinate math changes needed anywhere

decisions.decision: Damage formula: speed² × angleFactor × material.yoyoDamage × impactMultiplier × comboMultiplier / DAMAGE_SCALE (1200), replacing linear speed/15
decisions.rationale: Speed-squared creates a meaningful skill ceiling: 1-hit possible at max speed (~450 px/step), 3 hits at good play (~250 px/step), casual players take 5-9 hits. Glass/wood shield breakSpeeds lowered from 140/300 to 100/180 — wood shield at 300 was unreachable. DAMAGE_SCALE is a single named constant for easy post-play tuning.

decisions.decision: Migrated project management files (spec.md, CLAUDE.md, project-state.json, .gitignore, TEST_SPEC.md) to the frameworklite scaffold, preserving existing git history and game code as-is — no game files moved or renamed
decisions.rationale: Project was feature-complete (43/43 prior action items done); frameworklite's session-briefing/action-plan conventions add continuity without disrupting the working game or its commit history on origin/main
